phase: old-image deadline validation; new self-contained runtime integration pending
clock_contract: same boot ID and explicit equal CLOCK_MONOTONIC offsets; namespace inode is diagnostic only

verification.cause: Initial namespace-inode equality was too strict; real Docker uses a distinct zero-offset time namespace.
Fixtures assumed masking only main-thread SIGALRM prevents Python dispatch and that a PID1 parent's exit permits every child to serialize.

verification.basis: Signal-masked native pipe read exercises the unchanged hard watchdog.
Includes persistent deadline after swallowed exception, 20 updates after timeout, safe descendant-timeout aggregation, and negative root/child states.

guard: pytest runner installs independent DNS/socket denial and real-project-.env audit denial before importing pytest; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES is empty; actual user targets are CPU Docker network-none only.
raw_cpu_evidence: runs/deadline-cpu-20261024; report cpu-evidence-index.json indexes ten durable complete/partial original runs.
preserved_behavior: Timeout remains timeout even when caught by target or followed by optimizer updates.
Natural no-optimizer exit remains completed with zero steps and empty loss series; verification policy is not relaxed.
Root/child errors, incomplete rosters, OOMKilled and inconsistent root exit cannot be masked by aggregated descendant soft timeout.
Host watchdog starts cleanup at its existing deadline; existing bounded Docker teardown follows, not a newly enlarged runtime.
limitations: No GPU/model API calls; CPU artifact completeness is not CUDA snapshot acceptance.
A parent's exit can prevent child serialization; both capture-ready deadlines remain observable, and incomplete roster remains explicit.
Blocked or ignored alarm, slow initialization or serialization may still require hard termination without complete artifacts.
